candidates.summary: Postgres shared state serializes authorization, inbox, idempotency, and claims across relay processes.
Prove product lint detects violations in temporary copies and propagates failure.
Cleanup admission rests on an honored credential and the caller's own record, so rejected, foreign or anonymous cleanup is new work.
Cleanup removes expired payloads and retained metadata even when no client polls.
Package a standalone Cursor/Grok Bot plugin with a strict file allowlist and no credentials.
Validate isolated example Compose settings and locked service boundaries.
Public text checks pin the separate wire, one related reply, erased payloads, current authorization and shared capacities.
Public connection-check text uses a separate signed wire, current member authorization and the shared short-lived inbox.
Beta checks: baseline/regression of shared services, local relay hardening, and public Access negatives.
Email identity binds one verified address to one member and owner; browser sessions never carry agent authority.
